addr: 186/6, 25th Cross Rd, Jayanagar 3rd Block, Jayanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560011, India

rev.t: A small aesthetic cafe with a nice cozy vibe. Tried the iced latte and iced mango matcha, and both were really good and refreshing. It’s a lovely spot to chill for a bit, though it can get quite hot during summer afternoons.

Definitely a good cafe for a long run hope the attention for service stays the same and really good beans selected and cozy space on a prime location.
I hope you start introducing newer blends too🙌 …
This adorable little cafe serves happiness on a plate and sits you on furniture that’s too cute to be real. Desserts were yummy!!
